channel.title: Nicotine Science and Policy
channel.description: Daily digest of views, debates and discussions on nicotine science, policy, regulation and advocacy.

item.title: Smokers still getting the wrong message on vaping risks, English data shows
item.description: Only around 10% of smokers in England recognised vaping as less harmful than smoking in 2025, compared with approximately 40% in 2014, according to the latest Smoking Toolkit Study data. (Published on October 26, 2026byclearingtheair.eu)

item.title: Mice studies to simulate children exposure to “third hand” vaping are toxicological fiction
item.description: Animal studies investigating children's exposure to residual vaping aerosol have come under scrutiny for using experimental conditions that may not reflect real-world exposure. (Published on October 26, 2026bysubstack.com)

item.title: Hawaii Youth Vaping Plunges as More Adults Vape Than Smoke
item.description: Youth vaping in Hawaii declined by 66% between 2019 and 2025, while cigarette smoking among high school students reached its lowest recorded level. Meanwhile, more adults now report vaping than smoking, according to newly released survey data. (Published on October 26, 2026bythr101.org)

item.title: Belgium postpones terrace smoking ban
item.description: Belgium has postponed its planned ban on smoking and vaping on café and restaurant terraces, originally scheduled for January 2027, following objections from the Council of State and concerns raised by the hospitality sector. (Published on October 27, 2026bypolitico.eu)

item.title: Four times Sweden's tax: inside the EU's new plan for nicotine pouches
item.description: The EU's latest tobacco tax proposal could introduce a minimum excise duty on nicotine pouches more than four times Sweden's current rate by 2032. (Published on October 27, 2026byconsideratepouchers.org)
